messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: SLO p95 latency breach detected for route /v1/generate (region-us-east). Triggering SLO-based redispatch policy. Metrics: p95=750ms (SLO=500ms), QPS=420 -> threshold reached. Paging on-call for incidents channel.

pagerduty-bot: Paging Alice Nguyen (oncall) — escalation to Carol Singh in 3m if no ack.

Alice Nguyen: ack — I'm on it. joining call in 2m. Can someone drop recent routing decisions?

Ben Ortiz: grabbing logs from routing-controller. Seeing a flurry of redispatches to us-west-2 and eu-west-1 over the last 6m. Looks like policy weight shifts are oscillating every 30-45s.

Alice Nguyen: so SLO-trigger -> redispatch -> region congestion -> SLO-trigger back in origin -> redispatch back, repeat. That's the loop. Any errors?

Ben Ortiz: error rates small but increased tail in us-west workloads (timeouts from busy hosts). Here's a quick grep from the controller logs:

```
2026-03-15T18:41:02Z routing-controller INFO evaluate_policy route=/v1/generate p95=510ms -> redispatch to us-west-2 weight=0.6
2026-03-15T18:41:34Z routing-controller INFO evaluate_policy route=/v1/generate p95=740ms -> redispatch to eu-west-1 weight=0.7
2026-03-15T18:42:10Z routing-controller INFO evaluate_policy route=/v1/generate p95=780ms -> redispatch to us-east-1 weight=0.8
```

Carol Singh: paging we saw this pattern before. Hysteresis too tight on the SLO trigger (delta=0.05). Controller is reacting to transient p95 spikes. Recommend pausing SLO-driven autoswitch and fallback to static policy while we stabilize.

Alice Nguyen: agree. Quick mitigation: 1) disable auto-redispatch for /v1/generate 2) set static weights [us-east:0.7, us-west:0.2, eu-west:0.1] 3) increase p95 hysteresis to 20%. Who can apply?

Ben Ortiz: I can patch the routing-controller config and push canary immediately. Pushing a small change to prod config now.

Ben Ortiz: applying patch — rolling update to routing-controller-config (canary 10%)

Ben Ortiz: canary looks good, no immediate regressions. Promoting to 100% now.

Alice Nguyen: Carol, watch the dashboards for cascade. Dave, can you assess customer-facing impact?

Dave Miller: on it. Early glance from customer telemetry: 1.2% of sessions to top-tier customers saw >1s latencies, primarily those routed to eu-west. One enterprise (AcmeCorp) reported timeouts for heavy batch jobs between 18:42-18:47 UTC. Not seeing data loss, but retries spiking.

Carol Singh: after static weights are in, p95 is trending down to ~480ms in us-east, us-west stabilizing around 520ms. eu-west still a bit noisy at 580ms.

Alice Nguyen: good. Next step: re-enable SLO-driven routing but with larger hysteresis and a cooldown window (10m) to prevent flipflop. Ben, do we have rollout flags for that?

Ben Ortiz: yes — flags exist. I'll change hysteresis from 5% -> 20% and cooldown from 60s -> 600s. Rolling that now.

Ben Ortiz: flags updated. Controller config shows: "slo_hysteresis": 0.20, "cooldown_seconds": 600

incident-bot: NOTE: automated routing policies paused at 18:46:12 UTC by Ben Ortiz (config_change).

Carol Singh: monitoring looks much calmer. p95 across regions: us-east 470ms, us-west 510ms, eu-west 540ms. Overall p95 for /v1/generate is 495ms now.

Dave Miller: customer impact summary draft: ~1.2% sessions affected, one enterprise reported timeouts (retries mitigated most client failures), no SLA breaches logged yet but close. Suggested customer comms: proactive note to customers with retry guidance and ETA for follow-up.

Alice Nguyen: paging: handing off to Carol for post-incident ops and runbook updates. I'll annotate the incident and contact AcmeCorp SME. Carol, you own the follow-up ticket.

Carol Singh: taking it. I'll open INC-2026-2026-routing-surge (follow-up), include timeline, root-cause hypothesis (overly-sensitive SLO hysteresis + region capacity lag), and remediation plan: longer hysteresis, adaptive cooldown, and better capacity signal (queue depth) before redispatch.

Ben Ortiz: creating a short-term tweak to the policy eval to add queue depth check (only allow redispatch if target region queue depth < 0.6). Will PR and get it in the next patch.

Dave Miller: I'll draft customer comms and loop in support for targeted outreach to AcmeCorp.

incident-bot: Incident annotated: severity=sev2, active duration=~10m, mitigated by static-routing + hysteresis increase.

Alice Nguyen: thanks team. Postmortem action items: 1) update routing runbook with clear thresholds and cooldown defaults 2) add capacity signal to policy evaluation 3) alert tuning to avoid paging on single short p95 spike 4) customer comms template. I'll schedule a postmortem meeting tomorrow.

Carol Singh: adding tasks to INC-2026-2026 and assigning owners. Closing channel once follow-ups are created.

Ben Ortiz: small note — we should consider a graded fallback (deprioritize heavy model-variants first) to avoid moving full traffic across regions on short signals. Filing RFC ticket.

Dave Miller: :white_check_mark: I'll coordinate with PMs on fallback gradation and customer messaging.

Alice Nguyen: closing initial incident thread. Follow-ups in INC-2026-2026. Thanks everyone for fast response. :pray:
